description: List the user's Brand Voices (id, name).

description.description: List the user's Offer Briefs (id, name).

description.name: list_analyzed_pages
description.description: List Facebook pages the user analyzed (competitor, inspiration or brand_campaigns), with status and ad counts.

description.name: search_ads_library
description.description: Search the user's own Ads Library (ads collected by their searches) and this week's Top Ads by brand, niche, sector or copy. Returns ad ids usable with analyze_ad and run_ad_copilot.

description.name: get_market_creators_data
description.description: Aggregated stats of the creators/competitors the user monitors.

description.name: get_top_performing_ads
description.description: Top performing (longest running) ads of the monitored creators.

description.name: get_active_ads_copy
description.description: Copy (body, caption, CTA) of currently active ads of the monitored creators.

description.name: get_saved_ads
description.description: The user's swipe file, optionally filtered by competitor name.

description.name: get_strategic_avatar
description.description: Avatar research of a project (from list_projects): pain matrix, core wound, desire chain, objections, triggers, language and strategic synthesis.

description.name: get_competitor_active_ads
description.description: Active ads of a competitor the user has analyzed with Competitor Spy.

description.name: get_creative_analysis
description.description: Saved AI analysis of an ad (awareness, hooks, mechanism, triggers, landing page coherence), if analyze_ad was run on it.

description.name: get_job_status
description.description: Status and results of a background job started by an action tool.

description.name: run_competitor_spy
description.description: Scrape and analyze all ads of a competitor's Facebook page (uses 1 Competitor Spy credit). Runs in background: poll get_job_status with the returned id.

description.name: run_inspiration_search
description.description: Scrape and analyze a page outside the user's niche for inspiration (uses 1 Inspiration Search credit). Runs in background: poll get_job_status with the returned id.

description.name: run_brand_campaign_analysis
description.description: Scrape and analyze the user's own brand Meta campaigns page (uses 1 Brand Campaigns credit). Runs in background: poll get_job_status with the returned id.

description.name: run_ad_copilot
description.description: Adapt a library ad into 3 copy variants for the user's Avatar, Offer Brief and Brand Voice (uses 1 Ad Copilot credit). Runs in background: poll get_job_status with the returned id.

description.name: analyze_ad
description.description: Ads Intelligence: full AI analysis of one ad (emotional levers, biases, landing page coherence). Uses 1 Ads Intelligence credit. Runs in background: poll get_job_status with the returned id.

description.name: run_persuasion_analysis
description.description: Persuasion analysis of an ad before launch: present and missing cognitive biases (uses 1 Persuasion Analysis credit). Runs in background: poll get_job_status with the returned id.

description.name: run_sales_psychology
description.description: Sales Psychology report for a project's Avatar + an Offer Brief (uses 1 Sales Psychology credit). Runs in background: poll get_job_status with the returned id.

description.name: create_brand_voice
description.description: Create and save a Brand Voice from a public URL or a text (uses 1 Brand Voice credit, ~1 minute).

description.name: create_offer_brief
description.description: Create and save an Offer Brief from a public sales page URL or a text (uses 1 Offer Brief credit, ~1 minute).

description.name: run_magic_tool
description.description: Summarize, translate or extract contacts/links from a text (Magic Tools). Summaries and extractions are in the language of the text; translations go to `language` (default Italiano).

description: Write a sales psychology report that matches a project's customer avatar with an Offer Brief. Uses 1 Sales Psychology credit. Runs in the background: call get_job_status with the returned id to get the result.

labels.name: create_brand_voice
labels.description: Create and save a Brand Voice from a public web page or a text written by the user (about 1 minute). Uses 1 Brand Voice credit.

labels.name: create_offer_brief
labels.description: Create and save an Offer Brief from a public sales page or a text describing the offer (about 1 minute). Uses 1 Offer Brief credit.

labels.name: run_magic_tool
labels.description: Summarize or translate a text, or extract its contacts and links (Magic Tools). Summaries and extractions keep the language of the text; translations go to `language` (default Italiano).

description.name: list_followed_creators
description.description: Viral Content: the creators the user follows (platform, author_key, name, number of collected posts, last post date) and their follow limit.

description.name: get_followed_creators_contents
description.description: Viral Content: posts of the creators the user follows, newest first (24 per page). times_author_median is how many times the post beat the author's usual result. Filter by platform and author (author_key from list_followed_creators).

description.name: get_viral_content
description.description: Viral Content: one post (caption, metrics) with the user's saved analysis in that language, if any, and the vocabulary of persuasion mechanism codes to use in save_viral_analysis.

description.name: save_viral_analysis
description.description: Viral Content: save your 'why it works' analysis of a post (from get_viral_content) for the user, in one language. It appears in the app on that post, only for this user, and uses no Pantheon credits. Overwrites the user's previous analysis in that language. Base it on the caption and metrics only:

description.name: send_to_pantheon
description.description: Send a link to the user's Pantheon. Without a destination Pantheon picks it from the link: a TikTok, Instagram, YouTube or LinkedIn profile -> followed in Viral Content > My creators; a post -> its author is followed and the post is saved with its metrics; a Meta Ad Library link -> saved in the Swip

description.name: list_pantheon_inbox
description.description: Links the user sent to the Pantheon Whiteboard inbox and has not used yet (newest first).

description.name: list_radar_offers
description.description: List the user's offers that have the radar on, with their niche and target countries. Use the ids with get_ideas_matrix and build_ideas_matrix.

description.name: get_ideas_matrix
description.description: Get the ideas matrix of an offer: the angles (what an ad claims, to whom) and formats (style + structure) of the niche's ads, and the best angle x format combinations for the offer with why, an example hook, a score and how many niche ads already run it. Null when never built.

description.name: get_competitor_xray
description.description: Get the X-ray of a competitor page analyzed with the Competitor Spy: main angles, hooks that last, offer, gaps, style/structure/awareness mix and a swipe file. Null when never run.

description.name: build_ideas_matrix
description.description: Build (or rebuild) the ideas matrix of an offer from the ads of its radar. Uses 1 ideas matrix credit and 1 ad label credit per ad not labeled yet. Tell the user the cost and get their OK first. Runs in the background (1-2 minutes): call the matching get_ tool until status is done or failed.

description.name: run_competitor_xray
description.description: Run the X-ray of a competitor page analyzed with the Competitor Spy. Uses 1 X-ray credit and 1 ad label credit per ad not labeled yet. Tell the user the cost and get their OK first. Runs in the background (1-2 minutes): call the matching get_ tool until status is done or failed.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "search_meta_ads_live" is 975 chars, far longer than this server's median (186). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_followed_creators, get_followed_creators_contents, get_viral_content, list_pantheon_inbox · Private data: get_saved_ads, save_live_ads, run_magic_tool, send_to_pantheon, get_competitor_xray · Public sink: list_followed_creators, get_followed_creators_contents, get_viral_content, save_viral_analysis, send_to_pantheon · Destructive: get_market_creators_data, get_creative_analysis, run_competitor_spy, run_inspiration_search, run_brand_campaign_analysis, run_ad_copilot, analyze_ad, run_persuasion_analysis, run_sales_psychology, run_magic_tool, get_ideas_matrix, get_competitor_xray, run_competitor_xray.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_followed_creators, get_followed_creators_contents, get_viral_content, list_pantheon_inbox · Private data: get_saved_ads, save_live_ads, run_magic_tool, send_to_pantheon, get_competitor_xray · Public sink: list_followed_creators, get_followed_creators_contents, get_viral_content, save_viral_analysis, send_to_pantheon · Destructive: get_market_creators_data, get_creative_analysis, run_competitor_spy, run_inspiration_search, run_brand_campaign_analysis, run_ad_copilot, analyze_ad, run_persuasion_analysis, run_sales_psychology, run_magic_tool, get_ideas_matrix, get_competitor_xray, run_competitor_xray

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
